decision: Use Gemma 4 12B + mmproj for clipart vision via llama-mtmd-cli
rationale: Model already available locally, supports vision, 6.3GB fits VRAM with -ngl 20

decision: Use engagement panel transcripts as primary, Whisper as fallback
rationale: Engagement panels are cleaner (no hallucination), Whisper for no-panel videos
User directive: no skipping allowed - all videos must be attempted

decision: A6 digest format (4x6 inches) via Pandoc to LaTeX to PDF
rationale: Matches Seymour brand spec, small format for cabinet of curiosities feel

decision: 12 ponderables per volume, 2 volumes per sprint
rationale: Manageable authoring scope, consistent release cadence
